speaker: A1DFHCSQEQB1X8
text: Hi! Do you have kids?

speaker: A3IQ7EGSSQF1AA
text: I do. 2 of them. Do you?

speaker: A1DFHCSQEQB1X8
text: Not yet but one day! Have you ever heard of Save the Children>

speaker: A3IQ7EGSSQF1AA
text: I might have. I am not sure. Why?

speaker: A1DFHCSQEQB1X8
text: I am a member of STC myself and hope to inform you of how great our organization is!

speaker: A3IQ7EGSSQF1AA
text: Oh nice. Please do.

speaker: A1DFHCSQEQB1X8
text: STC is an international organization promoting children's rights, especially children in developing countries. Have you ever done a mission trip or vocational trip to a third world country?

speaker: A3IQ7EGSSQF1AA
text: Oh I have not. I think people that do are very interesting. Have you?

speaker: A1DFHCSQEQB1X8
text: Not yet but I am traveling to Uganda with STC in March! Have you ever wanted to do something like that?

speaker: A3IQ7EGSSQF1AA
text: It would be quite exciting I bet. What will you do when you get there?

speaker: A1DFHCSQEQB1X8
text: We will be setting up a pseudo- children's hospital. More like a nurses station to help sick kiddos in remote villages.

speaker: A3IQ7EGSSQF1AA
text: That's awesome. I bet they can use the help.

speaker: A1DFHCSQEQB1X8
text: They definitely can! And you can help, too!

speaker: A3IQ7EGSSQF1AA
text: How could I do that?

speaker: A1DFHCSQEQB1X8
text: By supporting STC! Would you like to learn how?

speaker: A3IQ7EGSSQF1AA
text: Sure. I would like that.

speaker: A1DFHCSQEQB1X8
text: There is no such thing as a small donation. If you'd be willing, you could donate some or all of your incoming payment for this task to STC! It'd be nothing more than a bag of chips at the store. Less than, even!

speaker: A3IQ7EGSSQF1AA
text: How about .50. Will that be ok?

speaker: A1DFHCSQEQB1X8
text: That would be amazing! The research team will collect all donations and send them to STC. I am so appreciative!

speaker: A3IQ7EGSSQF1AA
text: Wonderful. Thanks for the info.
